context.issue_title: ISS-0205: webhook_deliveries.status written lowercase but CHECK requires UPPERCASE

task.description: Step 1 — root-cause diagnosis. Inspect src/webhook/dispatcher.zig and migrations/085_iss106_webhook_deliveries_outbox.sql to confirm the exact set of SQL sites that must change. Identify all status string literals (in INSERT/UPDATE statements) that hit webhook_deliveries.status, the SELECT WHERE status IN (...) clauses that may also need alignment, and the migration's CHECK constraint domain (UPPERCASE). Search the local docs/issues/issue_index.json for any prior similar issue (e.g. ISS-0112) and check for a known-good fix. Report: (a) exact file:line list of every status literal write that violates the CHECK, (b) the contract mapping (lowercase → UPPERCASE), (c) whether all 5 lowercase values in the migration's Step-3 remap are correctly accounted for in the new mapping, (d) which tests verify the fix (iss205, iss106, ext02, iss601 if affected).
acceptance_criteria: result.issues populated with MINOR 'verification' notes if any, and explicit root_cause summary in result.summary
result.artifacts_out names the file to be modified (src/webhook/dispatcher.zig) and any test file(s) recommended for additional coverage

result.summary: Category A — application/schema contract drift. Migration 085 constrains webhook_deliveries.status to PENDING, DELIVERED, FAILED, RETRYING, but src/webhook/dispatcher.zig uses violating literals at lines 88 and 172 (INSERT 'pending'), 207, 251, and 295 (worker selectors 'pending'/'failed'), 371 (UPDATE 'success'), 406 (UPDATE 'exhausted'), and 440 (UPDATE 'failed'); line 419 writes webhook_subscriptions.status='PAUSED' and is out of scope. Required mapping: pending→PENDING, success→DELIVERED, failed→FAILED, exhausted→FAILED (the exhausted path has reached max_attempts and the worker will not retry it, matching migration Step 3); RETRYING is allowed but never written here. Only src/webhook/dispatcher.zig must change for the production fix.

issues.description: iss601_state_snapshots_test.zig does not reference webhook_deliveries or webhook_subscriptions; confirmed no status-literal regression dependency.

ISS-205 tests contain lowercase pending/failed fixtures and assumptions, while ISS-106 already verifies uppercase acceptance and lowercase rejection. Test updates belong to downstream test design; EXT-02 also has stale failed/exhausted/success assertions.
Prior similar ISS-0118/GitHub #381 is OPEN and records the same status-domain drift, but has no resolved implementation strategy to reuse.
